Checked on jfs-components 0.1.60 (2026-09-15); the installed package is 0.1.78. Re-check before relying on it.

The Breadcrumbs guide and its evidence were checked in September 2026 on jfs-components 0.1.60 and say the package has no Breadcrumbs ("the resolved package does not include Breadcrumbs"); its previews are drawn from NavArrow and Text. The installed 0.1.78 (mirror v0.1.78-dbe0e02) exports Breadcrumbs, and the entry's facts and examples come from it. Re-extract once the guide is re-checked on 0.1.78 and published (#521). Added by Claude Code in the overnight run agentpack-batch6, for Marcin to confirm.

"Chevrons, link treatment, and current-page state are supplied by the published component." says more than the installed Breadcrumbs.tsx does (read, not rendered): it adds the chevrons, but every crumb gets the same text style, so ancestors have no link colour and the current crumb is not set apart visually (it only gets aria-current on the web, selected on native). Guide fix #521. Added by Claude Code in the overnight run agentpack-batch6, for Marcin to confirm.

summary: Use Breadcrumbs when people need a compact path back through a hierarchy. The trail moves from the broadest ancestor to the current page.

useWhen.text: People need a compact path back through a hierarchy.

from.quote: Use Breadcrumbs when people need a compact path back through a hierarchy.

useWhen.text: The route has meaningful ancestors and the current page needs orientation.

from.quote: Breadcrumbs works when the route has meaningful ancestors and the current page needs orientation.

useWhen.text: Orient people above a report page when the route has meaningful ancestors.

from.quote: Orient people above a report page when the route has meaningful ancestors.

avoidWhen.text: In place of the page title or primary navigation: Breadcrumbs shows the hierarchy beside them, without replacing them.

from.quote: The published component communicates hierarchy without replacing the page title or primary navigation.
Do not duplicate primary navigation

anatomy.holds: The whole trail, built from items: it shows the hierarchy without replacing the page title or primary navigation.

from.quote: The published component communicates hierarchy without replacing the page title or primary navigation.

anatomy.holds: The items before the current page, from the broadest ancestor toward it. Each can take people back one level when onItemPress (or the item's own onPress) is given.

from.quote: Items are ordered from the broadest ancestor toward the current page. Each ancestor can take people back one level.

anatomy.holds: The separators between items, which express the path; the component adds them, so add no manual punctuation or duplicate chevrons.

from.quote: Separators express the path between items. Do not add manual punctuation or duplicate chevrons.

anatomy.holds: The item marked current (BreadcrumbItem.current), or the last item when none is marked.

from.quote: The last item is current unless an explicit current item is supplied.

placementAdvice.text: Place Breadcrumbs above page content, when the route supports backtracking.

from.quote: Use Breadcrumbs above page content when the route supports backtracking.

placementAdvice.text: Keep it secondary: it supports orientation and should not compete with primary navigation or the page heading.

from.quote: Breadcrumbs supports orientation. It should not compete with primary navigation or the page heading.

placementAdvice.text: The trail's width comes from its parent.

from.quote: Width comes from the parent.

placementAdvice.text: Keep a long route in its constrained parent so people can still parse each level.

from.quote: Keep a long route in its constrained parent so people can still parse each level.

configuration.text: items is the trail in route order, from the broadest ancestor to the current page; each item has a label.
The current page is the item with current: true; when no item has it, the last item is current. The current crumb is not pressable unless it has its own onPress.
Give onItemPress so ancestors can take people back: it is called with the pressed item and its index, and not for the current crumb unless that crumb has its own onPress.
Configure the content hierarchy (the items) and let the component render the path.

from.quote: Configure content hierarchy and let the published component render the path.

configuration.text: Do not draw chevrons, link styling or a current-page treatment yourself: the component supplies them.

from.quote: Chevrons, link treatment, and current-page state are supplied by the published component.

configuration.text: A constrained parent lets a long trail wrap; the component does not auto-collapse the route.

from.quote: A constrained parent lets a long trail wrap. The component does not auto-collapse the route.

configuration.text: Do not present a responsive collapse or an item count as a designer-selected control: the trail reflects the hierarchy and the available width.

from.quote: Do not represent a responsive collapse or item count as a designer-selected control.

configuration.text: Do not reverse the route to match a visual shortcut: the reading order stops matching the hierarchy and the current location becomes ambiguous.

from.quote: The reading order stops matching the hierarchy and current location becomes ambiguous.

rules.text: Start broad: order items from the broadest ancestor toward the current page.

from.quote: Order items from the broadest ancestor toward the current page.

rules.text: Preserve route order and keep the current page visible in the trail.

from.quote: Preserve route order and keep the current page visible.

rules.text: Name the current page: keep the final item concise and aligned with the page title.

from.quote: Keep the final item concise and aligned with the page title.

rules.text: Do not add manual punctuation or duplicate chevrons between items: the separators express the path, and the component supplies them.

from.quote: Do not add manual punctuation or duplicate chevrons.

states.when: The ancestors in route order, ending at the current page, such as Cloud, ITR, 2024-25, Original.

from.quote: Cloud → ITR → 2024-25 → Original.

states.when: A route longer than the line: the items wrap within the constrained parent.

from.quote: Items wrap within the constrained parent.

states.when: With onItemPress, ancestor items navigate; the current item stays current.

from.quote: Ancestor items can navigate; current remains current.

accessibility.text: The current page should agree with the visible heading and carry current-page semantics; the component marks the current crumb.

from.quote: The current page should agree with the visible heading and carry current-page semantics.

accessibility.text: The trail is announced as “Breadcrumb” unless accessibilityLabel names it.

doDont.do: Order the trail from ancestor to current
doDont.dont: Reverse the route to match a visual shortcut
doDont.why: The reading order stops matching the hierarchy and current location becomes ambiguous.

from.quote: Order the trail from ancestor to current

doDont.do: Let a long trail wrap inside its parent
doDont.why: The component does not decide to replace route levels with an ellipsis menu.

from.quote: Let a long trail wrap inside its parent

examples.purpose: A report page, the guide's In context: the trail sits above the page content, from the broadest ancestor to the current page (the guide's default trail: Cloud, ITR, 2024-25, Original); ancestors take people back through onItemPress.
examples.jsx:
<Breadcrumbs
  items={[
    { label: 'Cloud' },
    { label: 'ITR' },
    { label: '2024-25' },
    { label: 'Original', current: true },
  ]}
  onItemPress={() => {}}
/>

from.quote: Orient people above a report page when the route has meaningful ancestors.

examples.purpose: A long route: the trail wraps inside its parent instead of collapsing, so every level stays readable.
examples.jsx:
<Breadcrumbs
  items={[
    { label: 'Cloud' },
    { label: 'ITR' },
    { label: '2024-25' },
    { label: 'Original' },
    { label: 'Returns' },
    { label: 'Summary', current: true },
  ]}
  onItemPress={() => {}}
/>

from.quote: Keep a long route in its constrained parent so people can still parse each level.

props.name: items
props.description: Ordered trail from ancestor to the current page.

props.name: onItemPress
props.description: Called with the pressed item and its index. Not invoked for the current crumb unless that crumb supplies its own `onPress`.

props.name: modes
props.description: Design token modes forwarded to `HStack`, `Text`, and `Icon`.

props.name: testID
props.description: Test ID for the trail container.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Accessibility label for the trail. Defaults to `"Breadcrumb"`. Default "Breadcrumb", from the component source.

props.name: BreadcrumbItem.key
props.description: Optional stable key. Falls back to `label` + index. A field of each items row.

props.name: BreadcrumbItem.label
props.description: Visible crumb label. A field of each items row.

props.name: BreadcrumbItem.onPress
props.description: Called when this crumb is pressed. Takes precedence over the list-level `onItemPress` handler. A field of each items row.

props.name: BreadcrumbItem.current
props.description: Marks this crumb as the current page. When omitted, the last item is treated as current and is not pressable unless it has its own `onPress`. A field of each items row.

props.name: BreadcrumbItem.accessibilityLabel
props.description: Override announced to assistive tech. Defaults to `label`. A field of each items row.
